description: Header line folding is supported by validating each continuation line and appending it to the previous header value one at a time.

provenance.construction: reverse of 1b7a1dc9f3: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 4 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: Each continuation line is validated and concatenated onto the last header value, which copies the growing string every time, so a request made of very many tiny continuation lines costs quadratic CPU. GitHub rated the advisory medium (CWE-407, CWE-770).

issues.description: Every continuation line is appended to the last header value with +=, re-copying the growing string, with no limit on how many continuation lines a header can have.
